summary: A table of customer accounts with plan, seats, a health bar and monthly revenue, which people can search and filter by plan. Clicking a row opens a note on what the agent noticed about that account, with an optional button for the next step, such as drafting an email. It suits a customer success or sales view where an agent watches accounts for risk.
use: When an agent monitors customer accounts and flags the ones that need attention.
When account managers need to search and filter accounts by plan.
When each account's agent finding should lead to one action, like drafting a check-in email.
features: Columns for account (with a coloured letter logo), plan tag, seats, health and MRR.
Health is a bar coloured green from 80, amber from 60 and red below.
A search box matches account names, and plan chips filter by plan; the chips default to the plans found in `accounts`.
Clicking a row opens or closes the agent's `note` under it; one row is open at a time.
An optional `action` button in the open note; if its `onClick` returns a promise the button spins, then shows `doneLabel`.
Plan tags are coloured through `planTones`, and `emptyLabel` shows when nothing matches.
a11y: Each account row is focusable with tabIndex 0, exposes aria-expanded, and opens or closes with Enter or Space.
The plan filter is a role="group" labelled "Plan", and each chip uses aria-pressed.
The search input is labelled with its placeholder text, "Search accounts" by default.

faq.q: How do I add a "Draft email" button to the agent's note?
faq.a: Pass `action` with a `label`, an optional `doneLabel` and an `onClick` that receives the account. Return a promise and the button spins until it resolves, then shows the done label. If it rejects, the button goes back to its label.

faq.q: Can the agent open a row by itself?
faq.a: Yes. Control `open` with the account's name and update it from your own state, for example when the agent flags an account. Set it to null to close all rows.

faq.q: Does the table sort or format MRR for me?
faq.a: No. Rows appear in the order of `accounts`, and `mrr` is shown as the string you pass, so format it first, like "$14,400".

faq.q: Can I put links or formatting in the note?
faq.a: Yes. `note` takes any React node, so it can hold links, bold text or other elements.
